prompt638a_safety_bug_failure_layers.defect: When status='failed' and returncode_classification='failed' but returncode==0, line 107 (returncode==0 -> 'success') is evaluated BEFORE the failed-signal checks on lines 109-114, so the cycle is classified 'codex_result_success'. The explicit failed status/classification set by the live gate is silently overridden by the zero exit code.

final_status is derived solely from _cycle_stop_state(classification=...). per_cycle_effect_statuses are recorded into the payload (line 610) but never consulted when computing final_status/status. A cycle with effect status 'failed' can still yield final_status='success'.

Records per_cycle_effect_verification_statuses (lines 154-156) but the only gate (line 158) checks loop_state['status'] != 'success'. It never inspects per_cycle_effect_verification_statuses, so when loop_status='success' it proceeds to sandbox_cleanup, sandbox_commit_tag, final clean check, and sets status='success'.

prompt638a_success_gate_current_behavior: Final task success is gated ONLY on loop_state['status']=='success'. The loop's status is computed from the per-cycle classification, which treats returncode==0 as success even when the live gate explicitly returned status='failed'/stop_reason='effect_verification_failed'. per_cycle_effect_verification_statuses is never a gating input at any layer.
prompt638a_commit_tag_gate_current_behav: execute_sandbox_commit_tag runs whenever loop_status=='success' and sandbox cleanup succeeds. prompt638a_recommended_fix_summary: Implement a strict effect-verification success gate with defense in depth across three modules. (1) autonomous_cycle._result_status: honor explicit status/classification 'failed' before the returncode==0 success shortcut so a zero exit code cannot override an explicit failure. (2) autonomous_live_loop: incorporate per_cycle_effect_statuses into final_status — if any cycle effect status is 'failed' (or not 'passed' when verification was enabled), final_status must be 'blocked'/'failed', not 'success'. (3) run_task_queue_daemon._process_task: before sandbox cleanup/commit/tag, block when per_cycle_effect_verification_statuses contains any non-'passed' value; mark run_report status failed/blocked, route queue_final_path to failed instead of done, and never commit/tag. loop_status=success must be ignored if effect statuses contain 'failed'. Separately, the task1 effect spec required_text exact-substring is brittle; effect-spec generation should match the function regardless of type annotations (or assert def-name + return-expression) — but that is secondary; the gate is the safety-critical fix.
prompt638a_gate_owner_module: automation/orchestration/planned_runner/autonomous_live_loop.py (primary: final_status must reflect effect verification), with defense-in-depth gates in autonomous_cycle._result_status and scripts/run_task_queue_daemon.py
